diagnostic: Volume lessicale (~3500 vocaboli) e kanji (~1100) già da livello N3+/N2 base! Il focus primario deve essere sui connettori logici, verbi composti e Keigo per la Part B.

sample_sentences.meaning: I received chopsticks and a glass from my grandmother.
sample_sentences.japanese: 私わたしはお祖母ばあさんからおはしとコップをもらった。

sample_sentences.meaning: I'll buy you a cake that you like.
sample_sentences.japanese: あなたが好きなケーキを買かってあげよう。

sample_sentences.meaning: I (will do) study.
sample_sentences.japanese: 私わたしは勉強べんきょうをする。

sample_sentences.meaning: I did not like dinner.
sample_sentences.japanese: 晩ばんごはんが好すきではなかった。

sample_sentences.meaning: I will wash my hands before I eat.
sample_sentences.japanese: 食たべるまえに手てを洗あらいます。

sample_sentences.meaning: To watch TV until eight o'clock.
sample_sentences.japanese: ８はち時じまで、テレビを見みる。

sample_sentences.meaning: Won't you go shopping (with me) on Friday?
sample_sentences.japanese: 金曜日きんようびに、買かい物ものに行いきませんか。

sample_sentences.meaning: The only (one) thing that is great about her is her clothes.
sample_sentences.japanese: 彼女かのじょが素敵すてきなのは服ふくだけだ。

sample_sentences.meaning: Since I will give you some paper, take some notes. (away)
sample_sentences.japanese: 紙かみをあげるのでメモして。

sample_sentences.meaning: A mother speaking with a child: 'You will gradually lose interest in sweets.'
sample_sentences.japanese: お母かあさんが子供こどもと話はなしている：「あなたはだんだんおかしを食たべたくなくなる。」

sample_sentences.meaning: 'I am sorry because I cannot serve you anything but tea.'
sample_sentences.japanese: 「お茶ちゃしか出ださなくてすみません。」

sample_sentences.meaning: 'I want to live without regret.'
sample_sentences.japanese: 「後悔こうかいしないで生いきたい。」

sample_sentences.meaning: I blew out (extinguished) the candles on the cake.
sample_sentences.japanese: ケーキの上うえに乗のっていたロウソクを消けした。

sample_sentences.meaning: Don't say 'おまえ'. Please rephrase what you said!
sample_sentences.japanese: 「お前まえ」って言いうな。言いい直なおしてください。

sample_sentences.meaning: It means that you want to break up? (Phrase to noun)
sample_sentences.japanese: もう別わかれたいという事こと？

sample_sentences.meaning: I often hear that this restaurant is delicious. (Phrase to noun)
sample_sentences.japanese: この店みせは美味おいしいという事ことをよく聞ききます。

sample_sentences.meaning: I have to arrive at school by 8 o'clock.
sample_sentences.japanese: ８はち時じまでに学校がっこうにつかなくてはいけない。

sample_sentences.meaning: Around what time will you come home?
sample_sentences.japanese: 何時なんじ頃ごろ帰かえって来くる？

sample_sentences.meaning: We will talk later.
sample_sentences.japanese: あとで話はなしがある。

sample_sentences.meaning: Japanese is harder to speak than English.
sample_sentences.japanese: 日本語にほんごは英語えいごより話はなしにくい。

sample_sentences.meaning: Please speak as honestly as possible.
sample_sentences.japanese: なるべく正直しょうじきに話はなしてください。

sample_sentences.meaning: I want to go to as many famous places as possible.
sample_sentences.japanese: なるべく沢山たくさんの人気にんきな場所ばしょへ行いきたい。

sample_sentences.meaning: Even though I said it was impossible, you're still going to do it? (despite)
sample_sentences.japanese: 無理むりって言いったのにまだやるの？

sample_sentences.meaning: I can't speak English at all.
sample_sentences.japanese: 私わたしは全然ぜんぜん英語えいごを話はなせないです。

sample_sentences.meaning: I wonder if there is still cake in the fridge.
sample_sentences.japanese: 冷蔵庫れいぞうこにケーキまだあるかな。

sample_vocab.reading_meaning:
よろこぶ
- to be delighted [Vt] [Vi]
- to be pleased [Vt] [Vi]
- to be glad [Vt] [Vi]

むかえにいく
- to go to meet (someone)
- to go to pick up

おじさん
- Uncle (familiar language) (伯父さん is older than one's parent and 叔父さん is younger) [Ko] (honorific or respectful (sonkeigo) language)

じゅしん
- receiving (a message, letter, email, etc.) [Vs] [Vt]

はくしょ
- White paper (government report)

まじる
- To associate with [Vi] (usu. 交じる)

かわす
- to exchange (messages, greetings, arguments, etc.) [Vt]

にちひ
- Japan and the Philippines

あたり
- such as [Ko]
- about [Ko]
- Or thereabouts [Ko]

はなび
- Fireworks (work of art, literature, music, etc. name)

へ
- Towards (indicates direction or goal; pronounced え in modern Japanese; occ. written as 江)
